name: svecicezaauto
description: Auto ignition parts catalog and search service for the Serbian market. Browse 20,000+ parts across 8 categories: spark plugs, ignition coils, control units, ignition distributors, ignition modules, ignition cables, distributor drives, and resistors.

skills.name: Search Auto Parts
skills.description: Search for auto ignition parts by OEM part number. Returns matching parts with category and product page URL. Use the search index at /search-index.json for client-side lookup.

skills.name: Browse Part Categories
skills.description: Browse parts by category. Available categories: modul-paljenja (ignition modules), kontrolna-jedinica (control units), kalem-za-paljenje-bobina (ignition coils), razvodnik-paljenja (ignition distributors), svecice (spark plugs), pogon-razvodnika-paljenja (distributor drives), kablovi-za-paljenje-delovi (ignition cables), otpornik (resistors). Category pages at /kategorija/{slug}.

skills.name: Check Vehicle Compatibility
skills.description: View which vehicles are compatible with a specific part. Each product page at /proizvod/{id} lists compatible vehicle makes, models, engine types, and year ranges.
